annotations.title: Read the connected TikTok creator’s posting options

description: Read the connected TikTok creator’s REAL posting options BEFORE posting: which privacy levels THEY are allowed to use, whether comments / duet / stitch are available on their account, their maximum video length, and their nickname. TikTok REQUIRES that the user is shown these actual options and picks a privacy level — never assume or default one. Call this first, show the options, get the user’s pick, then call post_to_tiktok with destination:"post". The SAME privacy options govern PHOTO posts (slideshows), not just video — TikTok takes the same four levels on both. Needs TikTok connected (Connectors > TikTok).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected
